reference_contract.implementation_path: harness/pta_mnist.c golden_image() here; written apart and agreeing byte for byte, GRXCP docs/designs/pta_board_canary_golden.py
reference_contract.runtime_and_tool_versions: os: Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS (ubuntu 24.04); kernel: 6.18.33.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2; machine: x86_64; cc: gcc (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 13.3.0; cc_flags: -O2 -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -DN_SIDE=8 -DN_HID=64 -DN_OUT=16, linked with -lm; ld: GNU ld (GNU Binutils for Ubuntu) 2.42; libc: ldd (Ubuntu GLIBC 2.39-0ubuntu8.9) 2.39; python3: Python 3.12.3
reference_contract.operation_order: FC1: sum of input x weight, plus bias, ReLU, rescale, hold; FC2 the same; the CPU's conversion to 6-bit codes; FC3: sum of code x weight code, the converter's code; the CPU's class: code x 512 plus bias, the largest
reference_contract.integer_rounding_and_tie_rules: every rounding half up: the rescale (v + 256) >> 9; the conversion (x + 2) >> 2; the converter floor(s / 32 + 1/2); the pooling (2s + 9) div 18; the input (127p + 127) div 255
reference_contract.saturation_and_overflow_rules: FC1 and FC2 held at 0 by the ReLU and at 127 after the rescale; the conversion held at 31; the converter held to -128..127, a held code a range fault, none in either set; every sum in int32 with room, none can overflow
reference_contract.per_layer_scales_zero_points_and_shifts: zero points 0 throughout; FC1 and FC2 shift 9; FC3's activation and weight codes are the operands over 4; the converter's step is 32 of FC3's code sums, 2^9 of its operand sums
reference_contract.bias_units_and_application_order: FC1 and FC2: int32 in their sums' units, added before the ReLU; FC3: int32 in units of 2^-9 of a code, added to code x 512 for the class only, never to the reference
reference_contract.argmax_tie_break_rule: the lowest output index of those equal; none of the acceptance or calibration vectors ties
reference_contract.status: executable: two implementations agree byte for byte; independent review pending

gate_f.pta_shot_rule: one ordered vector per shot; do not average output values over repeats
gate_f.denominator_validity: sum(reference^2) over the full acceptance tensor must be positive; otherwise NRMS is undefined and the acceptance calculation halts for review without substituting a different denominator
gate_f.repeat_reporting: report each run and repeat-to-repeat variation separately, including fixed-between-calibration error
gate_f.range_rule: manifest range covers reference minimum and maximum; any clipping is a range fault
gate_f.tail_reporting: report count and fraction beyond the ruled threshold
gate_f.per_run_normalized_rms_percent: 100 * sqrt(sum((output - reference)^2) / sum(reference^2)) over 1,000 vectors x 16 outputs, in codes
gate_f.output_scale: one scale for FC3, the least-squares slope through the origin of calibration_fc3_reference on the PTA's codes over the calibration set, the PTA's codes times it; fixed once a calibration, never on the acceptance vectors
gate_f.physical_rms_band_figure: the per-run normalised rms with the output scale, both edges inclusive

physical_tail_threshold_and_allowed_coun.figure: the outputs times the output scale against the reference, to the nearest code

gate_f.class_agreement_figure: the class of the outputs times the output scale, with their biases, against the reference's class
gate_f.repeat_to_repeat: reported apart: the model gives 0.043 points from repeat to repeat on one source, 0.497 from source to source
gate_f.status: ruled by the freeze's owner on 2026-10-15 (GRXCP B22), by the rule GRXCP wrote before the canary's model run (2026-10-15T01:13:20Z); a band per board is an open question
